title: Fix #62631: Auto-filter Runs tab for PartitionedAssetTimetable DAGs
body:
Summary

  Addresses reviewer feedback from #62631 — replaces the dedicated
  "Partitioned Runs" tab with a filter-based approach on the existing Runs tab.

  Changes

  - DagRuns.tsx**: When a DAG uses `PartitionedAssetTimetable` and no
    `run_type` filter is set, automatically redirect to
    `?run_type=asset_triggered` so only asset-triggered runs are shown by default
  - Dag.tsx**: Removed the conditional `PartitionedRuns` tab entry and
    `useMemo` wrapper (react-compiler handles memoization automatically)
  - router.tsx**: Removed `partitioned_runs` route and `PartitionedRuns` import
  - dag.json**: Removed `partitionedRuns` translation key
  - PartitionedRuns/**: Deleted the dedicated component entirely

  Behavior

  - Consumer DAGs with `PartitionedAssetTimetable` → Runs tab auto-filters
    to `asset_triggered` runs on first open
  - User can clear or change the filter using the existing filter UI
  - Other DAGs → Runs tab opens normally with no auto-filter
  - Global runs page (`/dag_runs`) → unaffected (no `dagId` in params)

   Notes

  - No extra network call: `useDagServiceGetDagDetails` reuses the
    react-query cache already warmed by `Dag.tsx`
  - Redirect uses `replace` so the browser Back button works correctly

  Fixes #62564
